options: плед
пледа
пледу
пледом
cases.explain: Плед is the subject of the verb упал, so it stands in the nominative.

options: библиотека
библиотеки
библиотеке
библиотекой
cases.explain: «В» meaning location (where something is, not motion into) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Говорят, у Тургенева от ___ сделалась грудная жаба.
options: подагра
подагры
подагре
подагрой
cases.explain: The preposition «от», giving the cause or source, always takes the genitive.

options: окно
окна
окну
окном
cases.explain: Окно is the direct object of закрою; as an inanimate neuter noun its accusative looks like the nominative.

options: двор
двора
двору
дворе
cases.explain: «На» here marks a place, not motion towards it, so it requires the prepositional.

options: свеча
свечи
свече
свечой
cases.explain: «С(о)» in the sense of accompaniment («together with») takes the instrumental.

cases.sentence: Я тебя липовым ___ напою, ножки твои согрею...
options: чай
чая
чаю
чаем
cases.explain: Напоить takes the instrumental for the substance given to drink, and the adjective липовым agrees with it.

cases.sentence: Сейчас пройдет ___, и все в природе освежится и легко вздохнет.
options: дождь
дождя
дождю
дождем
cases.explain: Дождь is the subject of пройдет, and subjects stand in the nominative.

cases.sentence: Десять лет тому назад я встречал ее у покойной ___.
options: сестра
сестры
сестре
сестрой
cases.explain: The preposition «у» (at someone's place) always governs the genitive, and покойной agrees with it.

options: Бог
Бога
Богу
Богом
cases.explain: The verb молиться governs the dative — you pray to someone, so Бог takes the dative form Богу.

reading.ru: Я сейчас задремал и мне снилось, будто у меня левая нога чужая.
reading.question: What had Serebryakov just dreamed when he woke at the start of the act?
options: That his left leg belonged to someone else
That he was lecturing again in his old auditorium
That the house was on fire
That Sonya had run away from home
reading.correct: That his left leg belonged to someone else
reading.explain: He dozed off by the open window and woke from the pain, having dreamt his left leg was not his own.

reading.ru: Двадцать минут первого.
reading.question: What time does Elena Andreevna say it is when Serebryakov first asks?
options: Twenty minutes past midnight
Twenty minutes past one in the afternoon
Half past eleven
Just before dawn
reading.correct: Twenty minutes past midnight
reading.explain: «Двадцать минут первого» means twenty minutes into the first hour, i.e. 12:20 at night.

reading.ru: Утром поищи в библиотеке Батюшкова.
reading.question: What does Serebryakov ask Elena to look for in the library in the morning?
options: A volume of the poet Batyushkov
His unfinished article
A medical handbook on gout
A map of the estate
reading.correct: A volume of the poet Batyushkov
reading.explain: He repeats the request twice, saying he thinks they have Batyushkov in the house.

reading.ru: Говорят, у Тургенева от подагры сделалась грудная жаба.
reading.question: Which writer does Serebryakov mention as having developed angina from gout?
options: Turgenev
Batyushkov
Tolstoy
Pushkin
reading.correct: Turgenev
reading.explain: He fears the same will happen to him, since he too suffers from gout.

reading.ru: Вторую ночь не спишь.
reading.question: What does Elena point out about her husband's nights?
options: That this is the second night he has not slept
That he sleeps all day and complains at night
That he slept soundly until the storm woke him
That he only sleeps after taking his drops
reading.correct: That this is the second night he has not slept
reading.explain: She explains his heavy breathing by simple exhaustion — it is his second sleepless night.

reading.ru: Он столько же понимает в медицине, как я в астрономии.
reading.question: How does Serebryakov judge Doctor Astrov's medical knowledge?
options: He says Astrov understands medicine as well as he himself understands astronomy
He says Astrov is the best doctor in the district
He says Astrov only knows how to treat peasants
He says Astrov trained in Kharkov and is well qualified
reading.correct: He says Astrov understands medicine as well as he himself understands astronomy
reading.explain: The comparison is sarcastic: he means Astrov understands nothing about medicine.

reading.ru: И мне некогда, мне нужно завтра рано вставать, у меня сенокос.
reading.question: Why does Sonya say she has no time to indulge her father's whims?
options: She has to be up early because of the haymaking
She has to drive into town for medicine
She has to sit up with her grandmother
She is leaving the estate the next day
reading.correct: She has to be up early because of the haymaking
reading.explain: Sonya runs the estate work and must rise early for the hay harvest.

reading.ru: На дворе гроза собирается.
reading.question: What does Voynitsky announce when he comes in in his dressing gown carrying a candle?
options: That a thunderstorm is gathering outside
That the doctor has already driven away
That the samovar is still on the table
That the hay has all been mown
reading.correct: That a thunderstorm is gathering outside
reading.explain: His line is immediately followed by the stage direction «Молния» — lightning.

reading.ru: Не оставляйте меня с ним!
reading.question: How does Serebryakov react to Voynitsky's offer to take over the night watch?
options: He begs the women in fright not to leave him alone with Voynitsky
He gratefully accepts and sends the women to bed
He asks Voynitsky to fetch the doctor instead
He falls asleep in the middle of the offer
reading.correct: He begs the women in fright not to leave him alone with Voynitsky
reading.explain: He says twice that Voynitsky will talk him to death — «Он меня заговорит».

reading.ru: Самовар со стола не убран.
reading.question: Why does Marina say she cannot go to bed yet?
options: The samovar has not been cleared from the table
She has to keep watch over the professor
She is waiting for the watchman to come in
She has to prepare the horses for the doctor
reading.correct: The samovar has not been cleared from the table
reading.explain: Sonya tells her to lie down, and Marina answers that the table is not yet cleared.

reading.ru: Я тебя липовым чаем напою, ножки твои согрею...
reading.question: What does Marina promise Serebryakov as she leads him off to bed?
options: Lime-blossom tea, warmed feet and her prayers for him
A glass of brandy and a game of cards
A double dose of the doctor's drops
That she will send for his old colleagues
reading.correct: Lime-blossom tea, warmed feet and her prayers for him
reading.explain: She also adds «Богу за тебя помолюсь» — she will pray to God for him.

reading.ru: Вот уже третью ночь не сплю.
reading.question: How many nights has Voynitsky gone without sleep?
options: Three
One
A whole week
He does not say
reading.correct: Three
reading.explain: Elena is exhausted from sitting with her husband; Voynitsky says he is worn out by himself, and it is his third sleepless night.

reading.ru: Оставим философию!
reading.question: How does Voynitsky answer Elena when she lists everyone's quarrels in the house?
options: He tells her to leave philosophy alone
He agrees and promises to make peace with his mother
He asks her to go and play the piano
He walks out of the room without a word
reading.correct: He tells her to leave philosophy alone
reading.explain: Elena argues that the world perishes from petty squabbles; Voynitsky brushes the argument aside.

reading.ru: Иван Петрович, вы пьяны!
reading.question: What does Elena say to Voynitsky as he presses his declaration of love?
options: That he is drunk
That she will tell her husband
That he sounds exactly like the doctor
That she has always loved him
reading.correct: That he is drunk
reading.explain: She looks at him intently and accuses him of being drunk; he only answers «Может быть».

reading.ru: Тогда ей было семнадцать, а мне тридцать семь лет.
reading.question: How old were Elena and Voynitsky when they first met ten years earlier?
options: She was seventeen and he was thirty-seven
She was twenty-seven and he was forty-seven
She was seventeen and he was twenty-seven
She was seven and he was seventeen
reading.correct: She was seventeen and he was thirty-seven
reading.explain: He met her at his late sister's house and now regrets never having proposed.

reading.ru: Мыльный пузырь!
reading.question: What image does Voynitsky finally use for the professor and his life's work?
options: A soap bubble
A dry well
A broken clock
A felled forest
reading.correct: A soap bubble
reading.explain: He says that after the professor not a single page of real work will remain — he is nothing, a soap bubble.

reading.ru: Роскошная женщина.
reading.question: What does Astrov say when he hears that Elena Andreevna has just been in the room?
options: That she is a magnificent woman
That she is a cold, empty woman
That she ought to leave the estate
That she reminds him of Sonya's mother
reading.correct: That she is a magnificent woman
reading.explain: He comes in tipsy, thinks he heard her voice, and calls her «роскошная женщина».

reading.ru: Обыкновенно я напиваюсь так один раз в месяц.
reading.question: How often does Astrov say he normally drinks himself into this state?
options: About once a month
Every single evening
Only at Christmas and Easter
Twice a week
reading.correct: About once a month
reading.explain: He admits he is drunk and says such bouts happen roughly once a month, making him bold to the point of insolence.

reading.ru: Сами вы пейте, если это вам не противно, но, умоляю, не давайте пить дяде.
reading.question: What does Sonya first ask Astrov to do when she calls him back through the door?
options: Not to let her uncle drink
To stay at the house until morning
To examine her father once more
To take her with him to his forest
reading.correct: Not to let her uncle drink
reading.explain: She says drink is bad for Voynitsky; Astrov answers that they will not drink any more.

reading.ru: В человеке должно быть все прекрасно: и лицо, и одежда, и душа, и мысли.
reading.question: What does Astrov say ought to be beautiful in a person?
options: The face, the clothes, the soul and the thoughts
Only the soul, whatever the face may be
The work a person does and nothing else
The family name and the education
reading.correct: The face, the clothes, the soul and the thoughts
reading.explain: He says this while criticising Elena, who is beautiful but does nothing and lives an idle life.

reading.ru: В великом посту у меня больной умер под хлороформом.
reading.question: What memory makes Astrov cover his eyes and shudder?
options: A patient of his died under chloroform during Lent
His own house burned down in the spring
He was once refused by a woman he loved
He was beaten by peasants on a night call
reading.correct: A patient of his died under chloroform during Lent
reading.explain: Sonya tells him it is time to forget it, but the death still haunts him.

reading.ru: О, как это ужасно, что я некрасива!
reading.question: What does Sonya lament when she is left alone after Astrov leaves?
options: That she is not beautiful
That the doctor will never come back
That her father does not love her
That she must give up the estate
reading.correct: That she is not beautiful
reading.explain: She recalls overhearing a woman outside the church call her kind and generous but a pity she is so plain.

reading.ru: Давайте выпьем брудершафт.
reading.question: What does Elena propose after she and Sonya are reconciled?
options: That they drink Bruderschaft together
That they wake the professor and tell him
That they walk in the garden until dawn
That they send a note after the doctor
reading.correct: That they drink Bruderschaft together
reading.explain: They drink from one small glass and kiss, and from then on address each other as «ты».

reading.ru: Он и лечит, и сажает лес...
reading.question: How does Sonya sum up the doctor when she asks Elena to talk about him?
options: He both heals people and plants forest
He drinks and plays cards like everyone else
He writes books and gives lectures
He keeps the accounts of the estate
reading.correct: He both heals people and plants forest
reading.explain: Elena replies that the point is neither the forest nor the medicine, but his talent.

reading.ru: Не стучи, барин нездоров.
reading.question: What does Elena call out of the window to Yefim the watchman?
options: Not to knock, because the master is unwell
To harness the horses for the doctor
To let the dogs out into the garden
To go and fetch Marina at once
reading.correct: Not to knock, because the master is unwell
reading.explain: The watchman answers that he is going away at once and whistles for his dogs, Zhuchka and Malchik.

reading.ru: Соня (вернувшись). Нельзя!
reading.question: How does Act Two end?
options: Sonya comes back to say that Elena may not play the piano
Elena plays the piano and weeps
The watchman walks into the dining room
Serebryakov finally falls asleep in his chair
reading.correct: Sonya comes back to say that Elena may not play the piano
reading.explain: Elena longs to play, but music irritates the sick professor, so Sonya returns with a single word: «Нельзя!»

highlight.question: Which sentence says that Sonya's late mother used to lie awake at night grieving over the professor's illness?
sentences: Что, батюшка?
Больно?
У меня у самой ноги гудут, так и гудут.
(Поправляет плед.) Это у вас давняя болезнь.
Вера Петровна, покойница, Сонечкина мать, бывало, ночи не спит, убивается...
Очень уж она вас любила...
highlight.explain: Marina remembers Vera Petrovna, Sonya's dead mother, sitting up whole nights in distress.

highlight.question: Which sentence gives the ages of Elena and Voynitsky when they first met?
sentences: Десять лет тому назад я встречал ее у покойной сестры.
Тогда ей было семнадцать, а мне тридцать семь лет.
Отчего я тогда не влюбился в нее и не сделал ей предложения?
Ведь это было так возможно!
И была бы она теперь моею женой...
highlight.explain: Only the second sentence names the two ages, seventeen and thirty-seven.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes how Voynitsky and Sonya squeezed the estate and traded its produce to send the professor money?
sentences: О, как я обманут!
Я обожал этого профессора, этого жалкого подагрика, я работал на него как вол!
Я и Соня выжимали из этого имения последние соки; мы, точно кулаки, торговали постным маслом, горохом, творогом, сами не доедали куска, чтобы из грошей и копеек собирать тысячи и посылать ему.
Я гордился им и его наукой, я жил, я дышал им!
highlight.explain: The third sentence lists the oil, peas and curds they sold in order to send him thousands.

highlight.question: Which sentence says how often Astrov usually drinks himself into this state?
sentences: Как?
Да... Надо сознаться - становлюсь пошляком.
Видишь, я и пьян.
Обыкновенно я напиваюсь так один раз в месяц.
Когда бываю в таком состоянии, то становлюсь нахальным и наглым до крайности.
Мне тогда все нипочем!
highlight.explain: Only that sentence gives the frequency — once a month.

highlight.question: Which sentence describes what is happening to the hay and the weather on the estate?
sentences: Сено у нас все скошено, идут каждый день дожди, все гниет, а ты занимаешься миражами.
Ты совсем забросил хозяйство...
Я работаю одна, совсем из сил выбилась...
(Испуганно.) Дядя, у тебя на глазах слезы!
highlight.explain: The first sentence says the hay is all mown, it rains every day, and everything is rotting.

highlight.question: Which sentence states Astrov's verdict on an idle life?
sentences: В человеке должно быть все прекрасно: и лицо, и одежда, и душа, и мысли.
Она прекрасна, спора нет, но... ведь она только ест, спит, гуляет, чарует всех нас своею красотой - и больше ничего.
У нее нет никаких обязанностей, на нее работают другие...
Ведь так?
А праздная жизнь не может быть чистою.
highlight.explain: The closing sentence declares that an idle life cannot be a pure one.

highlight.question: Which sentence says that Astrov failed to understand Sonya's hint about a younger sister?
sentences: Он ничего не сказал мне...
Душа и сердце его все еще скрыты от меня, но отчего же я чувствую себя такою счастливою?
(Смеется от счастья.) Я ему сказала: вы изящны, благородны, у вас такой нежный голос...
Разве это вышло некстати?
Голос его дрожит, ласкает... вот я чувствую его в воздухе.
А когда я сказала ему про младшую сестру, он не понял...
highlight.explain: The last sentence reports that he did not grasp what she meant by the younger sister.

highlight.question: Which sentence pictures the doctor planting a sapling and already imagining what will come of it in a thousand years?
sentences: Не в лесе и не в медицине дело...
Милая моя, пойми, это талант!
А ты знаешь, что значит талант?
Смелость, свободная голова, широкий размах...
Посадит деревцо и уже загадывает, что будет от этого через тысячу лет, уже мерещится ему счастье человечества.
Такие люди редки, их нужно любить...
highlight.explain: Only that sentence describes the planted sapling and the thousand years ahead.
